body:
IGN: Zegita

I would like to appeal this infraction because I am truly sorry for spawn killing. I thought it wasn't spawn killing because I couldn't even hit the players because of their resistance so I didn't really spawn kill. I haven't got an infraction in a really long time and this is a really stupid infraction that I achieved so I am desperately sorry for doing this. Furthermore, I was not verbally warned by any moderator prior to my warning which makes it annoying because I didn't get told by anyone which is what a moderator should have done. Please look into this and I hope my infraction gets lifted because this is really stupid :(. I'd rather get a chat warning then this because of how stupid this is for me. Thanks for taking your time to read this

Any extra information come talk to me

title: Spawn Killing

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Since it was done with the intent to spawn kill, regardless of what resistance they may have had, the warning is valid. (Plus, you did kill a couple of the players in spawn). Stupid or not, you broke a rule and got the warning.

Considering according to the punishment guidelines the first offense typically for spawn killing is a kick, I'd say this warning does the same thing a verbal warning would do. 

Here's the evidence for future reference. 
https://youtu.be/t3pgYQEBhWc
